meanings.usage: 与exam同义，日常生活中更常用
形容非常不好或令人不悦的事物

phrases.usage: 用于询问某事持续了多长时间

examples.en: How long did the exam last?
How long did the meeting last?
How was the exam? Not too bad.
I think I passed in English.
I think I failed the French paper.
I could answer sixteen of the questions.

phrases.usage: 表示对某人来说太...（而不适合）

examples.en: They were too difficult for me.
The exam was too hard for me.
The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
examples.zh: 试卷对我来说不够简单。

examples.en: Oh, cheer up!

phrases.usage: 表示做得还不错，不是很糟糕

examples.en: Perhaps we didn't do too badly.

phrases.usage: 写一个字（强调什么都没写）

examples.en: He didn't write a word!
I hate them.

grammar.title: 一般过去时特殊疑问句
grammar.structure: 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？
grammar.definition: 询问过去发生的事情的时间、原因、方式等信息的疑问句 用于询问过去动作的具体信息，如时间、原因等

examples.en: How long did the exam last?
What did you do yesterday?
When did she leave?

grammar.title: too...to 与 enough...to 结构
grammar.structure: too + 形容词 + (for sb) + to do sth / 形容词 + enough + (for sb) + to do sth
grammar.definition: 表达'太...而不能'和'足够...可以'的含义 too...to表示否定含义，enough...to表示肯定含义

examples.en: They were too difficult for me.
The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
examples.zh: 试卷对我来说不够简单。

examples.en: The book is easy enough to read.
examples.zh: 这本书足够简单，可以阅读。

examples.en: He is too young to go to school.

grammar.title: 情态动词 could 的用法
grammar.structure: 主语 + could + 动词原形
grammar.definition: could 表示过去的能力或可能性 表示过去能够做某事（能力）或能够做到某事（可能性）

examples.en: I could answer sixteen of the questions.
I couldn't answer the rest.
Could you speak English then?

patterns.pattern: How long did + 主语 + 动词原形 + (其他)?

original.en: How long did the exam last?

imitations.en: How long did the movie last?
How long did the trip last?

patterns.pattern: 主语 + think + 主语 + passed/failed + in + 科目

original.en: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
original.zh: 我想我英语和数学通过了。

imitations.en: I think I passed in History.
She thinks she failed in Physics.

patterns.pattern: too + 形容词 + for + 人称代词/名词

original.en: They were too difficult for me.

imitations.en: This problem is too hard for students.
imitations.zh: 这个问题对学生来说太难了。

imitations.en: The book is too boring for children.
imitations.zh: 这本书对孩子来说太无聊了。

patterns.pattern: 形容词 + enough + (for + 人称代词/名词) + to do sth

original.en: The English paper wasn't easy enough for me.
original.zh: 英语试卷对我来说不够简单。

imitations.en: The seat isn't comfortable enough for him.
imitations.zh: 这个座位对他来说不够舒服。

imitations.en: The room is big enough for five people.
imitations.zh: 这个房间足够大，可以容纳五个人。

questions.q: How long did the exam last?

translation:
加 里：考试考得怎样，理查德？
理查德：不算太坏，我想我的英语和数学
及格了。题目很容易。加里，
你怎么样？
加 里：英语和数学试题对我来说不很容易。
我希望别不及格。
理查德：我想我的法语及不了格，我能回答
其中的16道题。这些题很容易。
但我回答不出其作的题。那些题对
我来说太难了。
加 里：法语太可怕了，你说呢？
理查德：我讨厌法语。我的法语成绩肯定
很低。
加 里：啊，别灰心！或许我们考得还不太
糟。坐在我旁边的那个人只在试卷
顶端写自己的名字。
理查德：是吗？
加 里：然后他就坐在那里，对着考卷看了3
个小时，一个字也没写！
